question: Under what condition is it claimed that the three worlds with all moving and unmoving things could be shaken?
premises: An angered agent is the one capable of action here.
The object is the three worlds with moving and unmoving things.
The action of shaking is presented as a potential act.
inference: If angered, such an agent may shake the entire triple world.
uncertainties: Whether the claim is literal or figurative remains open.
plain_english: O goddess, if angered, one may shake the three worlds together with all that moves and all that does not move.
